pictures.name: CFL1-Tara-Dark
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Night in early Irish countryside long ago: on a broad hill, the royal enclosure of Tara with round thatched halls inside earthen ramparts, every hearth dark. In the middle, an Irish High King with a long red-gold beard, in a deep green cloak fastened with a large gold brooch, a gold torc at his neck stands at the rampart edge in the cold blue night, arms folded, watching the black valley. A few guards with unlit torches behind him. Only starlight and a thin moon, deep blue everywhere, a faint gold glow from one covered ember pot at his feet. Stillness, tension, a land holding its breath. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CFL2-Slane-Fire
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A green Irish hilltop at night. In the middle, Saint Patrick, a weathered bearded man of about fifty in a plain undyed wool robe and a hooded brown cloak, holding a tall wooden staff, stands beside a newly lit bonfire, his staff raised, face lit warm gold. A small band of companions in plain wool cloaks kneel and stand around the fire, some holding small candles lit from it. Sparks rise into a deep blue starry sky; the dark valley falls away below. Joy, courage, Easter night. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CFL3-King-Sees
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The rampart of Tara at night, seen from behind the king. an Irish High King with a long red-gold beard, in a deep green cloak fastened with a large gold brooch, a gold torc at his neck and three grey-robed wise men with long white beards stand at the edge, looking out across a wide dark valley at one small bright fire burning on a distant hill. The wise men lean toward the king, warning him, their faces lit faintly gold from the far flame, the king in profile, troubled. Deep blue night all around, the distant fire in the middle of the picture. Awe, unease, wonder. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CFL4-Easter-Vigil
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The doors of a stone Catholic church at night, today. A small fire burns in a bronze brazier outside. A deacon in a white dalmatic holds a tall white Easter candle, freshly lit, decorated with a red cross and grains of incense; a priest in white vestments beside him, people with unlit candles gathered in the dark. The tall candle in the middle, its flame the brightest thing in the picture. Deep blue night, gold firelight on faces. Hushed expectation. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CFL5-Flame-Passed
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside a dark Catholic church during the Easter Vigil, today: a crowd of ordinary people of many ages and backgrounds stand in the pews holding thin white candles, passing the flame from one candle to the next, faces lit gold one by one. Far down the aisle, the tall Easter candle glows near the altar. In the middle, a grandmother tilts her candle to light her grown granddaughter’s, both smiling. Deep blue shadows retreating, gold light spreading. Wonder, peace, joy. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CFL6-Today-Votive-Rack
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A quiet side chapel in a Catholic church, today, afternoon. Rows of small votive candles in red and amber glass flicker on a wrought-iron stand beneath a painted statue of Mary. A young woman in a modern coat has just lit one, her hand still near the flame, eyes closed, coat collar up. A small wooden coin box beside the stand. Deep blue shadows in the stone chapel, warm gold candlelight on her face. The candles in the middle. Tenderness, hope. No text, no letters, no logos.
